1. Problem Statement

Modern students and researchers increasingly rely on Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize dense academic course materials, problem sets, and textbooks. However, general-purpose LLM chat interfaces present three critical limitations in academic settings:

  • Hallucination & Lack of Verifiability: AI models routinely produce plausible-sounding yet factually inaccurate statements without providing auditable, page-level citations or visual document evidence.
  • The Speculation Trap (No Refusal Cutoff): When course materials do not contain the answer, conventional chatbots speculate using general training data rather than admitting the answer is absent from the syllabus.
  • Context Loss & Prompt Injection Vulnerability: General interfaces fail to isolate user-uploaded documents from core instructions, risking syllabus confusion or adversarial prompt injection.

2. Why This Problem Statement Was Chosen

Academic study demands strict intellectual accountability: "Don't just answer the student; show them exactly where the answer came from."

"When university students prepare for exams or technical coursework, ungrounded speculation is worse than no answer. A student needs deterministic proof, exact equation citations, and the ability to verify original pages with confidence."
  • Pedagogical Rigor: In STEM courses (physics, linear algebra, engineering), answers must cite exact formula derivations and test parameters rather than hand-wavy approximations.
  • Verifiable Visual Proof: Combining conversational intelligence with high-resolution PDF page rasterization allows immediate visual confirmation of underlying diagrams, charts, and equations.
  • Editorial Focus: Designed with an academic, print-monograph reading aesthetic that promotes focused, distraction-free scholarship.

3. Approach & Proposed Solution

Vellum implements an end-to-end, production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture engineered specifically for provenance, explainability, and mathematical problem solving.

Paragraph-aware chunking with overlap & page provenance ? ? core/embeddings.py ??? Google gemini-embedding-001 (RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT / QUERY) ? ? core/vector_store.py ??? ChromaDB persistent vector database (SHA-256 deduplication) ? ? (Vector Similarity Search) ? core/retriever.py ??? Top-K candidate extraction, hybrid lexical boost & threshold ? ? core/llm.py (Rewriter) ??? Contextual query rewriting (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) ? ? [Student Question]
  • Paragraph-Aware Chunking: Documents are split along natural paragraph boundaries (\n\n), preserving intact formulas and page metadata (page_number, chunk_id, document_id).
  • Smart Hybrid Retrieval: Combines dense cosine similarity with lexical keyword overlap. Conceptual and analytical queries (theorems, formulas, problem sets) maintain semantic alignment, while off-topic queries are strictly filtered.
  • Deterministic Refusal: If no candidate clears the calibrated relevance threshold (MIN_RELEVANCE = 0.65), the LLM generation is bypassed entirely, returning an honest refusal message.
  • Step-by-Step Problem Solving: Prompts are engineered to extract given variables from problem sets and guide students through step-by-step mathematical procedures using $LaTeX$ typesetting.

4. Technologies & Tools Used

Layer / Component Technology Role in Project
Frontend & Interface Streamlit (v1.65+) Three-column reactive layout, chat streaming, session state management
Typography & Design CSS3, Cormorant Garamond, Manrope Print-monograph parchment styling, custom MutationObserver CSS bridge
Language Model Google Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) Conversational query rewriting, document insights, grounded answer generation
Embedding Engine Google gemini-embedding-001 768-dimensional text vectors with task-specific retrieval tuning
Vector Database ChromaDB Persistent on-disk vector store with cosine distance indexing & metadata filters
PDF Processing PyMuPDF (pymupdf / fitz) Page-level extraction, scanned page detection, and high-DPI page rendering
Testing & QA PyTest (43 tests) Comprehensive test suite covering chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and UI

5. Key Features & Functionality

Continuous 3-Column Desk

Organized desktop keeping library, conversation, and evidence citations simultaneously accessible without context switching.

Automated Document Insights

Generates high-yield summaries and 3 clickable starter study questions tailored to uploaded problem sets or lecture slides.

Context-Aware Query Rewriting

Follow-ups (e.g. "Explain that step in simpler terms") are automatically rewritten into self-contained standalone search queries.

Visual Proof & Page Render

The Evidence panel renders the exact rasterized PDF page image, letting students verify original layout and equations visually.

Step-by-Step Solutions

Formulates math problems (matrices, eigenvalues, wave equations) with complete step-by-step $LaTeX$ solutions and citations [1], [2].

Notes Export & Cloud Ready

One-click export of chat sessions into formatted Markdown study notes. Built-in support for Streamlit Cloud secrets management.
